title: Q3 Synced Roadmap: Hosted API Feature Phasing & Model Catalog Convergence
creator: Maya Chen
description: Quarterly planning ticket to align Hosted API feature phases with model catalog transitions for Q3. Objective is to produce a sequenced rollout plan that minimizes runtime risk, keeps SLAs intact, and preserves predictable unit economics while enabling new model variants in the catalog. This ticket coordinates cross-team decisions (runtime, infra, design, sales) and produces the final phased milestone plan for Product and Eng to execute. Scope includes feature gating, phasing of model variants, compatibility guardrails, customer migration guidance, and OKR mapping. Out of scope: Dedicated and Private-specific rollout mechanics (handled in separate tickets).
acceptance_criteria: Finalized phase schedule (canary -> staged -> GA) for all Hosted API features and model catalog entries targeted for Q3
Signed-off rollout checklist covering SLA targets, fallback policies, and customer communication templates
Mapped dependencies to engineering tickets with owners and dates (>=90% of dependencies have owners)
Updated OKR/initiative tracker with measurable milestones and owners
Playbook entry created in Confluence for migration and rollback with runbook links
